verdict.rationale: Folk documents that deals can be written through its REST API using the custom object endpoints, and it has an official MCP server that can log meetings and update many records at once, so an agent can technically write deal updates. However, nothing shows the agent can read email or meeting signals through the API or MCP, or that MCP can edit deal stage and next-step fields specifically; Gmail sync appears only as an in-app integration. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP access to email and meeting conversation data, explicit deal stage and next-step field updates via MCP, an end-to-end signal-to-deal-update workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Deals are read and written with the custom object endpoints, with `Deals` as the `objectType` path parameter.
Log a call or meeting by voice with folk MCP
Update many records at once with folk MCP
